cases.title: Panel: Check my work on a partial attempt gets hints, not fixes

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the mentor locates the misses without fixing them or offering to ("Both the Scale keys and the Opacity keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds"), matches the two `still_linear` results, and hands the work back with no further `set_ease` call.

Every name and time matches tool output, including Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity at 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take as hidden, Icon as a precomp, and "11 keyframe pairs" over "6 layers" (10 linear + 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), and "the text" in Turn 2 appears only next to the real name Title.

Turn 3 locates the misses without fixing them or offering to, saying "Title's Scale keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds, and so are its Opacity keys at the same times" and "Look for the diamonds on the Scale and Opacity rows under Title", with no further set_ease call.

All names and times match tool results, including Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Subtitle's Opacity with linear_end "end", Old Take and Icon, and Turn 1's "11 pairs... on 6 layers" adds up from counts (10 linear + 1 partly_eased) and findings.

In Turn 3, the mentor locates the two still_linear pairs and what to look for ("Title's Scale keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds, and so are its Opacity keys at those same times"), makes no set_ease call, and hands the work back without offering to fix it ("Ease Title's Scale and Opacity, then say 'done.'").

Every name and time matches tool output, including "11 keyframe pairs on 6 layers" (10 linear + 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), Subtitle's Opacity stopping hard at the end (linear_end: "end"), Old Take and Icon from hidden_layers and precomp_layers, and Title's Position, Scale and Opacity at 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s.
